sentences.en: Mina: Did you know that we can turn trash into something new and valuable?
sentences.ko: Mina: 우리가 쓰레기를 새롭고 가치 있는 것으로 바꿀 수 있다는 것을 알고 있었니?

sentences.en: We can even make an artwork out of it.
sentences.ko: 우리는 그것으로 예술 작품을 만들 수도 있어.

sentences.en: Today, my dog tore my bag apart, so I needed a new bag.
sentences.ko: 오늘 우리 강아지가 내 가방을 갈기갈기 찢어 놓아서, 나는 새 가방이 필요했어.

sentences.en: Instead of buying a new one or fixing the old one, I decided to upcycle my old jeans.
sentences.ko: 새것을 사거나 낡은 것을 고치는 대신, 나는 내 낡은 청바지를 업사이클하기로 결심했어.

sentences.en: Jeans are strong, so they are perfect for a bag.
I then found a how-to for making a bag from old jeans on the Internet and made a bag.
sentences.ko: 그러고 나서 나는 인터넷에서 낡은 청바지로 가방을 만드는 방법을 찾아서 가방을 만들었어.

sentences.en: I wanted to decorate the bag, so I used the pins and buttons from my old dresses.
sentences.ko: 나는 가방을 꾸미고 싶어서, 내 낡은 원피스에서 떼어 낸 핀과 단추를 사용했어.

sentences.en: I showed the bag to my friend, Suna, and she said that it looked unique and very nice!
sentences.ko: 나는 그 가방을 내 친구 수나에게 보여 줬고, 그녀는 그것이 독특하고 아주 멋져 보인다고 말했어!

prep.def: things that you throw away because you no longer want them or need them, such as old food, paper, or plastic
prep.example: Please don’t leave **trash** in the park.

prep.def: worth a lot of money, or very useful or important
a painting, drawing, or sculpture that someone creates
prep.example: Her **artwork** is shown in the school hall.
prep.example_ko: 그녀의 예술 작품이 학교 강당에 전시되어 있다.

prep.def: a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end
prep.example: Learning a language is a long **process**.

prep.ko: 업사이클하다 (헌 물건을 더 좋은 것으로 다시 만들다)
prep.def: to take old or thrown away materials and objects and change them into something new and usually better
prep.example: I **upcycled** an old box as a pencil case.

prep.def: to make something look more attractive by adding things to it
being the only one of its kind; unusually special
prep.example_ko: 모든 사람은 자기만의 독특한 목소리를 가지고 있다.

prep.def: to pull something into pieces, or to separate it by force
prep.example: The angry child **tore apart** the paper.

prep.def: to change one thing so that it becomes another thing
prep.example: The magician **turned the scarf into** a bird.

prep.def: instructions that show you the steps to do something
prep.example: I watched a **how-to** video about cooking.

prep.def: exactly right for a person or a use
prep.example: This small backpack is **perfect for** a short trip.
prep.example_ko: 이 작은 배낭은 짧은 여행에 딱 알맞다.

ws1.en: Mina: Did you know / that we can turn trash((쓰레기)) into something / new and valuable((가치 있는))?

ws1.ko: 우리는 심지어 예술 작품을 만들 수도 있다 / 그것으로

ws1.ko: 청바지는 튼튼하다 / 그래서 그것은 가방으로 딱 알맞다

ws1.en: I then found a how-to((방법)) / for making a bag / from old jeans / on the Internet / and made a bag.
ws1.ko: 그러고 나서 나는 방법을 찾았다 / 가방을 만드는 / 낡은 청바지로 / 인터넷에서 / 그리고 가방을 만들었다

ws1.en: I wanted to decorate((꾸미다)) the bag, / so I used the pins and buttons / from my old dresses.
ws1.ko: 나는 그 가방을 꾸미고 싶었다 / 그래서 나는 핀과 단추를 사용했다 / 내 낡은 원피스에서 나온

ws1.en: I showed the bag / to my friend, Suna, / and she said / that it looked unique((독특한)) and very nice!
ws1.ko: 나는 그 가방을 보여 주었다 / 내 친구 수나에게 / 그리고 그녀는 말했다 / 그것이 독특하고 아주 멋져 보인다고

ws8.answer: Mina: Did you know that we can turn trash into something new and valuable?
We can even make an artwork out of it.
Today, my dog tore my bag apart, so I needed a new bag.
Instead of buying a new one or fixing the old one, I decided to upcycle my old jeans.
Jeans are strong, so they are perfect for a bag.
I then found a how-to for making a bag from old jeans on the Internet and made a bag.
I wanted to decorate the bag, so I used the pins and buttons from my old dresses.
I showed the bag to my friend, Suna, and she said that it looked unique and very nice!
